learning_outcomes.text: Ability to draft, sign, and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering aimed at the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly, or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability to direct activities that are the object of engineering projects.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and aptitudes in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Ability to organize and plan within a company, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding, and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the Industrial Technical Engineer profession.

syllabus_topics: Registration with the External Placements Unit
Search for a company or institution for external placements
Consultation of company offers list in the URJC External Placements application
Advice and tutoring from the Mechanical Engineering Placement Coordinator
Proposal of a new company or institution for external placements
Confirmation of company compliance with URJC regulations
Providing company information for agreement signing (name, CIF, contact person, address, email)
Signing of the external placement agreement
Signing of the student annex to the external placement agreement with the assigned company
Student obligation: Incorporation to the entity on the established date
Student obligation: Compliance with calendar and schedule, and respect for entity operating rules (especially safety and hygiene)
Student obligation: Development of the training plan and diligent, responsible, and proficient completion of assigned activities
Student obligation: Confidentiality regarding internal information and non-use of work without express authorization
Submission of the External Placement Report
Ensuring the company tutor fills and submits their report
teaching_methods: Any formative activity included in the Training Project of the External Placements Collaboration Agreement aimed at complementing university education and familiarizing students with the professional environment

assessment_methods.method: Report prepared by the student describing activities carried out in the company
Report issued by the company tutor (Annex II)
Academic tutor's assessment of the placements

assessment_rules: The qualification will be issued based on the Report prepared by the student, describing the activities carried out in the company, and the Report issued by the company tutor (Annex II), and the academic tutor of the placements. Revision and appeals will be carried out according to the Regulations for External Academic Placements of Universidad Rey Juan Carlos. The use of artificial intelligence is prohibited in any assessment exercise or test unless explicitly indicated by the professor. In such cases, precise instructions on its use will be provided.
